title: Quasi-triangular dual pre-Poisson bialgebras and its connection with Poisson bialgebras
summary: In this paper, the notions of quasi-triangular and factorizable dual pre-Poisson bialgebras are introduced. A factorizable dual pre-Poisson bialgebra induces a factorization of the underlying dual pre-Poisson algebra, and the double of any dual pre-Poisson bialgebra is factorizable. We introduce the notion of quadratic Rota-Baxter dual pre-Poisson algebras and show that there is a one-to-one correspondence between factorizable dual pre-Poisson bialgebras and quadratic Rota-Baxter Poisson algebras of nonzero weights.
